note: The signing page's own wording, in plain words. Applied over OpenSign's English strings at image build (deploy/opensign-frontend-patches.mjs), which fails if upstream no longer has a key. scentic-ceremony.js tells the page's state by the titles and sentences marked in `states`; deploy/tests checks the two agree.

locale.enter-otp: We emailed you a 6-digit code. Enter it to open the document.
locale.get-otp-alert: To keep this document private, we’ll email a code to this address.
locale.invalid-otp: That code isn’t right, or it has expired. Check your latest email, or send a new code.
locale.enter-otp-alert: Please enter the code from your email.
locale.valid-email-alert: Please enter a valid email address.
locale.something-went-wrong-mssg: We couldn’t open this just now. Please refresh the page. If it happens again, the link may no longer be available — please contact the person who sent it to you.
locale.user-not-found: We couldn’t find a signing request for this email address. Please check the address, or contact the person who sent you the link.
locale.user-not-exist: We couldn’t open this document for you. Please contact the person who sent you the link.
locale.document-deleted: This document is no longer available. Please contact the person who sent it to you.
locale.document-not-found: This document is no longer available. Please contact the person who sent it to you.
locale.document-signed-alert-7: This document is no longer available.
locale.decline-alert-1: Are you sure you want to decline this document? Nobody will be able to sign it afterwards.
locale.decline-alert-2: You declined this document. Nothing more is needed from you.
locale.decline-alert-3: This document was declined, so it can no longer be signed.
locale.document-signed-alert-6: This document was declined by one of the people asked to sign it.
locale.expired-on-mssg: This document could be signed until {{expiredDate}}. Please contact the person who sent it to you.
locale.document-signed-alert: Thank you. You have signed this document.
locale.document-signed-alert-1: Thank you. You have signed this document. You can download or print a copy now; once everyone has signed, you will receive the completed document.
